meta.name: Short Dudo
meta.blurb: A short bluffing dice game: bid on a face with 1s wild, then raise, call Dudo or call Calza, and the loser of each call loses a die.

rules:
Players sit in a fixed seat order and each starts with {start_dice} dice. Seat {first_opener_seat} opens round 1. There is no talk: bids and calls are the only communication.

Each round:
1. ROLL. Every player still in the game rolls as many six-sided dice as they hold. You see only your own dice. Everyone is told the total dice in play (T = {total_dice} at the start of the round) and every player's dice count.
2. OPENING BID. The opener chooses a face from {min_bid_face} to {max_bid_face} and a quantity Q with max({opening_min_floor}, floor(T/{opening_min_divisor})) <= Q <= ceil(T/{opening_max_divisor}). The bid means 'at least Q dice among all players show this face, with every 1 counting as this face'. The bid is announced to all.
3. RESPONSE 1. The next player in seat order who is still in the game chooses one of: Raise +{raise_small} (raise1_faceF: quantity +{raise_small}, any face F from {min_bid_face} to {max_bid_face}); Raise +{raise_big} (raise2_faceF: quantity +{raise_big}, any face F); Dudo (challenge the current bid as false); Calza (claim the count is exactly the current quantity). A raise is not offered if the new quantity would exceed T; if both raises would, only Dudo or Calza may be chosen. The choice is announced. A player who raises becomes the current bidder.
4. RESPONSE 2. Only if response 1 was a raise: the next player in seat order after the current bidder who is still in the game makes the same kind of choice. With 2 players, this is the opener again.
5. FINAL RESPONSE. Only if response 2 was a raise: the next player in seat order after the current bidder who is still in the game must choose Dudo or Calza. Raising is not allowed.
6. REVEAL. All dice are shown. N is the number of dice showing the current bid face plus the number showing 1.
7. SETTLE. Dudo: if N >= the current quantity, the caller loses {dudo_loss} die; otherwise (N is less than the quantity) the current bidder loses {dudo_loss} die. Calza: if N equals the current quantity exactly, the caller gains {calza_gain} die, up to a maximum of {max_dice}; otherwise the caller loses {calza_loss} die.
8. ELIMINATION. A player with 0 dice is out and is skipped in seat order from then on.
9. NEXT OPENER. The player who lost a die opens the next round. After a successful Calza, the caller opens. If that player was eliminated, the next player in seat order who is still in the game opens.
10. END CHECK. If only one player remains, the game ends and that player wins. If {max_rounds} rounds have been played, the game ends and the player holding the most dice wins; players tied for the most dice share the result as a draw.
